purpose: Determine which independently compiled species traits have enough coverage and variation among NAAMP response-eligible species to support a finite functional-community analysis. No rainfall-response association is fitted in this audit.

eligibility_rule_for_later_analysis.binary_trait: at least 18 complete matched species and both levels represented by at least 3 species
eligibility_rule_for_later_analysis.continuous_trait: at least 18 finite positive/valid species and nonzero variance
eligibility_rule_for_later_analysis.functional_panel: prefer one nonredundant trait from each ecological axis (morphology, habitat, activity, reproductive mode) that passes coverage; do not add traits after rainfall-response readback

prohibited: no response-trait association in this audit
no trait selection based on wet/dry effect direction
no post-readback expansion of the finite trait panel
